title: 归来 (The Return)
style: The target video is a photorealistic live-action Chinese vertical short drama in 9:16 with cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, a 50mm-equivalent lens look, subtle film grain, and finely detailed faces with natural skin texture.

linxia.name: Lin Xia
linxia.look: a 28-year-old Chinese woman with an oval face, softly arched brows, almond-shaped dark-brown eyes with long curled eyelashes, a small beauty mark under her left eye, refined makeup with soft brown eyeshadow, thin eyeliner and a muted rose-red lip, long wavy dark-brown hair falling past her shoulders with a side part on the right, wearing a deep-red satin slip evening gown with thin straps and small pearl stud earrings.
linxia.keep: beauty mark under the left eye, long wavy dark-brown hair with the right side part, rose-red lip makeup, deep-red satin slip gown and pearl stud earrings
linxia.face_detail: long curled eyelashes, a small beauty mark under the left eye, fine skin texture with a natural sheen, soft brown eyeshadow and a muted rose-red lip.
linxia.voice_en: in a warm, slightly low female voice
linxia.voice_design: 二十八岁左右的成年女性，音色温暖、略偏低沉，普通话标准，语速中等偏慢，压抑着愤怒与委屈，尾音带一点颤抖。
linxia.voice_sample: 我等了你整整三年，每天晚上都站在这扇窗前，看着这座城市的灯一盏一盏地熄灭。
linxia.hair: long wavy dark-brown hair falling past the shoulders with a side part on her right, worn loose
linxia.costume: a deep-red satin slip evening gown with thin straps, ankle length, black pointed-toe high heels, small pearl stud earrings, no other jewellery

luchen.name: Lu Chen
luchen.look: a 32-year-old Chinese man with a lean face, a sharp jawline, straight thick brows, narrow dark eyes, a thin pale diagonal scar on the nose bridge, short black hair neatly swept back, clearly visible light stubble on his jaw and upper lip, wearing a black two-piece suit over a white shirt with an open collar and no tie.
luchen.keep: thin scar on the nose bridge, swept-back short black hair, light stubble, black suit and open-collar white shirt
luchen.face_detail: a thin pale scar on the nose bridge, light stubble, fine skin texture, and dark eyes catching a small lamp highlight.
luchen.voice_en: in a deep, calm male voice
luchen.voice_design: 三十二岁左右的成年男性，音色低沉、沉稳，普通话标准，语速偏慢，克制冷静，几乎没有情绪起伏，句尾干脆利落。
luchen.voice_sample: 有些事情你不需要知道，你只需要相信我。今晚跟着我走，别回头，也别出声。
luchen.hair: short black hair neatly swept back, light stubble
luchen.costume: a black two-piece slim suit, white shirt with an open collar and no tie, black leather oxford shoes, no jewellery

penthouse.name: penthouse living room
penthouse.look: a luxury penthouse living room at night with floor-to-ceiling windows showing the glittering Shanghai skyline with the Lujiazui towers, including the Oriental Pearl Tower, across the Huangpu River, low warm brass table lamps, a dark grey marble floor, a charcoal velvet sofa, and a dark wooden doorway on the right leading into shadow.
penthouse.keep: the floor-to-ceiling windows, the Shanghai Lujiazui night skyline, the brass table lamps, the dark grey marble floor, the charcoal velvet sofa and the doorway position
penthouse.light: night; warm brass table lamps as the key light against the cool blue night skyline through the windows

wine_glass.name: crystal wine glass
wine_glass.look: a tall, thin-stemmed crystal Bordeaux glass, one-third filled with dark red wine, no markings.
wine_glass.keep: the tall thin stem, clear crystal bowl and the one-third fill of dark red wine
